##### <a name="-conman--server"></a>`server`

Data type: `Boolean`

Boolean that sets host to act as conman server

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-conman--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

Module ensure property

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-conman--conman_server"></a>`conman_server`

Data type: `Stdlib::Host`

Hostname of conman server

Default value: `$facts['networking']['fqdn']`

##### <a name="-conman--conman_port"></a>`conman_port`

Data type: `Stdlib::Port`

The port for conman server

Default value: `7890`

##### <a name="-conman--cfgfile"></a>`cfgfile`

Data type: `String`

The conman configuration file

Default value: `'/etc/conman.conf'`

##### <a name="-conman--consoles"></a>`consoles`

Data type: `Hash`

Hash of `conman::console` resources

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-conman--manage_repo"></a>`manage_repo`

Data type: `Boolean`

Manage repo to install conman, only used on EL8

Default value: `true`

## Defined types

### <a name="conman--console"></a>`conman::console`

Define a conman console

#### Examples

##### 

```puppet
conman::console { 'compute01':
  device   => 'ipmi:bmc-compute01',
  ipmiopts => 'U:admin,P:bmcpassword',
}
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `conman::console` defined type:

* [`device`](#-conman--console--device)
* [`log`](#-conman--console--log)
* [`logopts`](#-conman--console--logopts)
* [`seropts`](#-conman--console--seropts)
* [`ipmiopts`](#-conman--console--ipmiopts)
* [`order`](#-conman--console--order)

##### <a name="-conman--console--device"></a>`device`

Data type: `String`

The console device, maps to `dev` in conman.conf

##### <a name="-conman--console--order"></a>`order`

Data type: `String`
